title: Notifications Center
description: Standalone notification inbox — a bell trigger with an unread badge that opens a panel (popover on desktop, sheet on mobile) listing notifications with All/Unread tabs, per-row mark-read + dismiss, and bulk mark-all-read + clear. Adapter-driven: the host supplies the feed via a NotificationsAdapter (Convex, websocket, or the bundled in-memory store). Pure UI, no backend coupling, theme-token styling.
